text: {"features":[{"evidence":"Every security team I have seen has the same bottleneck: too many signals, too few experts.","name":"Role thesis","description":"This dimension captures whether the letter is organized around a specific, memorable, role-relevant idea rather than a generic statement of interest.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Opens generically and gives little distinctive, role-specific framing."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows clear interest in the role, but the framing is familiar or only loosely developed."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a clear role-relevant thesis or analogy that gives the letter a recognizable shape."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a memorable, specific thesis and sustains it through the rest of the letter to sharpen the application."}]},{"evidence":"Having reviewed the posting closely, I believe my background aligns directly with the stated requirements of the role.","name":"Requirement mapping","description":"This dimension captures how explicitly the letter connects the applicant's experience to the job posting's named qualifications and responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Makes little direct connection to the posting beyond naming the role."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions some relevant qualifications, but the mapping to the posting is mostly implicit."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly addresses several core requirements or responsibilities from the posting."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Systematically maps experience to the posting, with explicit coverage of the main requirements and responsibilities."}]},{"evidence":"Doctoral degree in computer science","name":"Academic attainment","description":"This dimension captures the level of formal relevant education presented in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Bachelor's degree or unclear equivalent only."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Master's degree in a relevant technical field."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Doctoral degree in a relevant technical field."}]},{"evidence":"7 years of software development experience ... testing, maintaining, and launching 6 production services","name":"Production delivery scope","description":"This dimension captures the depth of real-world software delivery experience, especially repeated production ownership across testing, maintenance, and launch.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Production experience is minimal, weakly specified, or below the role's baseline."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Meets the baseline with a few years of experience and at least one or two concrete production launches."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows several years of work and multiple production services across testing, maintenance, and launch."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows an extensive, repeated production track record with broad ownership over several launched and maintained systems."}]},{"evidence":"Go is my principal programming language.","name":"Go prominence","description":"This dimension captures how central Go appears to the applicant's actual professional work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Go is mentioned, but depth or centrality is unclear."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Go is a regular working language in production work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Go is clearly presented as the primary, principal, or daily production language across meaningful systems."}]},{"evidence":"My Python is production-grade, not just scripting: typed, tested services and tooling that other engineers extend without fear.","name":"Python maturity","description":"This dimension captures the depth and production seriousness of the applicant's Python experience.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Little or no Python evidence is given."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Python is mentioned for scripts or general tooling, with limited depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Python is used regularly for services, automation, or internal tooling in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Python practice is clearly production-grade, with signs of engineering rigor such as typed, tested, extensible services or widely used tooling."}]},{"evidence":"shipped LLM-backed features and hardening them against unpredictable inputs","name":"AI deployment depth","description":"This dimension captures how much concrete, production-oriented experience the letter shows with AI systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No AI experience is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"AI is mentioned only broadly, aspirationally, or in exploratory terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows concrete experience shipping AI or LLM-backed features in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI experience plus explicit evaluation, hardening, reliability controls, or other operational safeguards."}]},{"evidence":"Python agents with clear contracts, Go infrastructure that makes their boundaries impossible to wander past","name":"Agent design maturity","description":"This dimension captures how concretely the applicant describes designing agentic systems, especially with operational constraints and supervision.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No agentic tooling experience is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or agentic pipelines only at a high level."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agent systems end to end, typically with Python agents paired with Go services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes deliberate agent design with explicit contracts, constraints, guardrails, supervision, or boundary enforcement."}]},{"evidence":"automated the intake and triage of vulnerability reports, turning an unstructured queue into a routed, prioritized pipeline","name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"This dimension captures direct experience building systems that automate security-response workflows such as report triage, routing, or variant handling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No direct security automation example is given."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in automating security work, but cites no shipped workflow."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Cites automation around vulnerability handling in general terms."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a concrete shipped workflow for vulnerability triage, classification, routing, or deduplication."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Describes a concrete shipped workflow plus clear operational impact, measured benefit, or an explicitly scaled security-response mindset."}]},{"evidence":"conducted formal security assessments of both new designs and existing production services, documenting findings and verifying their remediation","name":"Security review practice","description":"This dimension captures hands-on experience assessing systems for security weaknesses and following the work through.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No hands-on security assessment experience is shown."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims security assessment experience, but without methods or concrete examples."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows concrete assessment work such as threat modeling, code review, design review, or attack-surface analysis."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows concrete assessment work plus remediation verification, a clearly articulated assessment approach, or repeated cross-service review experience."}]},{"evidence":"turned a brute-force correlation job into a streaming computation through better structure choice alone","name":"Algorithmic sophistication","description":"This dimension captures evidence of applying data-structure or algorithmic reasoning to materially improve systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no algorithmic evidence beyond generic competence claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims strong algorithmic ability, but with little supporting detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one concrete example of using algorithms or structure choice to improve a real system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides especially strong or multiple examples showing algorithmic reasoning materially changed performance, tractability, or system design."}]},{"evidence":"defaults, not documents, are what busy engineers actually follow in practice","name":"Security philosophy","description":"This dimension captures how clearly the letter articulates a view of security as an engineering practice that helps developers do the right thing by default.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little articulated view of how security should be practiced."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States interest in security impact, but mostly in general terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly expresses a developer-enabling security philosophy, such as secure defaults, proactive help, or security as engineering."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a nuanced security philosophy that closely matches the team's mandate and clearly informs how the applicant builds systems."}]},{"evidence":"improvements there are inherited by every team downstream","name":"Platform orientation","description":"This dimension captures motivation for central, foundational work whose benefits scale across many teams rather than a single product surface.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little evidence of interest in shared foundations or broad organizational leverage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions wider impact, but only vaguely or briefly."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly values high-leverage infrastructure or capacity-building work across an organization."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly frames impact in terms of shared foundations, scaled judgment, or improvements inherited by many teams."}]},{"evidence":"maintainer of an actively used open-source project, with responsibility for contribution review and releases","name":"Open-source stewardship","description":"This dimension captures the extent of the applicant's responsibility and consistency in open-source contribution or maintenance.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No open-source activity is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional patches or small contributions."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular contribution or some ongoing responsibility for an open-source project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows active maintenance responsibility, such as review, releases, roadmap ownership, or stewardship of a widely used project."}]},{"evidence":"built a distributed task queue with exactly-once semantics","name":"Personal build ambition","description":"This dimension captures the technical ambition and seriousness of self-directed projects outside the applicant's formal job scope.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No personal project is mentioned, or only a minimal note with little technical substance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small side build that shows curiosity but limited complexity."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions a substantive project with meaningful systems design or implementation depth."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Mentions an ambitious self-directed build that tackles hard engineering problems such as distributed systems, reliability, or recovery semantics."}]},{"evidence":"placed near the top of several well-attended capture-the-flag competitions","name":"Offensive practice","description":"This dimension captures ongoing adversarial security practice outside ordinary software engineering work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No adversarial security practice is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional CTF participation or a general interest in attacker thinking."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular CTF participation or other ongoing offensive practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong external evidence of offensive skill, such as near-top placements in substantial competitions."}]},{"evidence":"I took the OSCP certification.","name":"Security certification","description":"This dimension captures formal external validation of security knowledge or hands-on security skill.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No security certification is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a foundational credential such as Security+ or a similar baseline certification."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions a hands-on, practice-heavy credential such as OSCP or an equivalent advanced security certification."}]},{"evidence":"most recently redesigning an in-memory index that sat on our hottest request path","name":"Evidence concreteness","description":"This dimension captures how consistently the letter backs claims with specific recent examples, implementation details, or observed effects.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mostly makes assertions with little supporting detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Provides some examples, but many claims remain abstract or ungrounded."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Backs several important claims with concrete examples, mechanisms, or recent work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently grounds claims in specific examples, implementation details, and observed effects across the letter."}]},{"evidence":"frequent misspellings such as taht, develpoment, and consdiered","name":"Writing accuracy","description":"This dimension captures the mechanical polish of the letter, especially whether spelling and copy-editing errors distract from the case being made.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent mechanical errors materially distract from credibility or readability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Noticeable errors appear throughout, but the meaning remains clear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Only minor occasional errors appear, with generally polished presentation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Writing is clean and highly polished, with little or no mechanical distraction."}]}]}
